name: 排球（一传到位/扣球）评分

map.排球（一传到位/扣球）评分是做什么的？: What does Volleyball Skill Rating (Pass / Spike) do?
map.如何使用排球（一传到位/扣球）评分？: How do I use Volleyball Skill Rating (Pass / Spike)?
map.排球（一传到位/扣球）评分适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Volleyball Skill Rating (Pass / Spike) best for?
map.排球技术评分工具，从一传到位率和扣球成功率两个核心维度评估排球技术水平，结合发球: A volleyball skill rater that scores technique from two core dimensions: pass accuracy and spike success, combined with serve and block for a composite rating.
map.排球技术成功率 = 各项成功数 ÷ 尝试数 × 100%（接发/扣球/发球/拦网: Volleyball skill success rate = successful attempts ÷ attempts × 100% (pass/spike/serve/block); the composite rating is a weighted sum by skill.
map.一传和扣球是排球最核心的两大技术环节: Passing and spiking are the two most core volleyball skills
map.一传到位率50%以上为合格，70%以上为优秀: A pass-accuracy rate above 50% is acceptable and above 70% is excellent
map.扣球成功率40%以上为合格，50%以上为优秀: A spike success rate above 40% is acceptable and above 50% is excellent
map.发球得分率和拦网成功率也是重要技术指标: Serve scoring rate and block success rate are also important technical indicators
map.一传到位率、扣球成功率。: Pass accuracy and spike success rate.
map.训练赛给一传与扣球技术打分，定位一传到位率波动的技术环节。: Score passing and spiking in training matches to pinpoint the technical link behind swings in pass accuracy.
map.到位率决定战术组织质量。: Accuracy determines the quality of tactical organization.
map.评分主观怎么减偏？: How do I reduce subjectivity in rating?
map.用固定评分量表加多人独立评，取均值减个体宽松度偏差。: Use a fixed rating scale with several independent raters and average them to reduce individual leniency bias.
map.排球技术评分工具从一传到位率、扣球成功率、发球和拦网4个维度评估排球技术水平，按: The volleyball skill rater assesses technique across four dimensions (pass accuracy, spike success, serve and block) and computes a weighted composite rating, helping players and coaches quantify technical performance.
